about_the_game:
《Cat Vs Slime 猫咪大战史莱姆》— Where tower defense meets gravity and stacking fun, a two-sided feline defense battle is about to begin!

This isn’t your average tower defense game: the gravity mechanics on the 2D platform add endless variables to the battlefield. Cats can stack like a pyramid, easily reaching slimes fluttering in the air. Meanwhile, enemies rushing on the ground and swimming in the water will launch simultaneous attacks from both left and right, targeting the cat house you’re defending—doubling the strategic depth instantly!

Need to hit airborne foes? Just let cats stand on their pals’ heads to form a "meow tower"! As the battle progresses, you’ll randomly unlock new cats and strengthen your cat house. The light roguelike elements ensure every playthrough brings fresh surprises. With 30 unique cat warriors and 90 upgradeable development paths, you can craft your own playstyle—whether it’s a tanky defense line or an unstoppable damage squad!

Ready to command this fluffy army, and fend off wave after wave of slime attacks in a mix of gravity and strategy?
